# DogsBay DITA tutorial — Part 5: Governance and the finish

## Part 5: Governance and the finish

- [Stage 23: Drafts and localization](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-5-governance/stage-23-drafts-and-localization.md): Mark the guide for review and translation with a language on every root, translate flags, a right-to-left phrase, sort keys, review markup and a change history.
- [Stage 24: House rules](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-5-governance/stage-24-house-rules.md): Write the house style as Schematron, name it in the project config so the gate enforces it, explain it to agents, and fix the ten violations it finds.
- [Stage 25: Final](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-5-governance/stage-25-final.md): No new DITA. The README lists every stage and every deliverable, the branch is tagged tutorial/final, and the full gate builds all eight deliverables clean.
